sec_bulk.authority: SEC Insider Transactions Data Sets, as-filed Forms 3/4/5 flattened data
sec_bulk.security_type_rule: Form 3/4/5 non-derivative Table I titles are supplementary instrument evidence only and never listed-class authority; listed security type requires an exact historical ticker/class co-occurrence in a contemporaneous SEC periodic or registration filing cover

identity_policy.current_sec_company_tickers_role: discovery-only exact-ticker CIK hint; never historical identity authority

coverage_policy.planning_gate: evidence must be usable strictly before the first unresolved canonical observation in the affected domain
coverage_policy.final_admission: all unresolved security-type and sector observations must have strict-prior admitted evidence; conflicts and ambiguous identity remain fail-closed

web_fallback.partitioning: unique validated CIK/source objects, not calendar year
web_fallback.source_selection_window: selection is anchored to the first unresolved observation and limited to the three preceding filing years plus that observation's calendar year; later same-year source bytes may be retained for completeness but can never be admitted unless filed strictly before the decision session
web_fallback.global_request_governor: single sequential client; minimum 0.25 seconds between requests with explicit SEC throttle/backoff handling
